basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Project Assistant & Project Attendant Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has released the official Senior Project Assistant & Project Attendant Notification 2026 at https://home.iitd.ac.in/. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under the IIT Delhi Senior Project Assistant & Project Attendant Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with a Graduate degree in Arts/ Science/ Commerce or Business Management with 5 years of experience (for Senior Project Assistant), or 12th pass with 2 years of experience (for Project Attendant) can apply through email up to 03 August 2026. At least 5 years of experience in the actual conduct of meetings/examinations and office procedures. Knowledge of office procedures, rules & regulations operative in Govt. office or in an educational institute, including experience in handling work in connection with meetings & Conferences. how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Project Appointment posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 03 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Appointment at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Project Appointment positions at IIT Delhi, including Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) and Project Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Attendant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Project Attendant post is passing the 12th class (10+2) with at least 2 years of experience in handling office work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) position ranges from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350/- per month, plus HRA @30%.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. The subject line of the email must contain the advertisement number IITD/IRD/186/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the official website for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Delhi recruitment, where you can find more details and the application form, is http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for these positions?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for these Project Appointment positions.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the required experience for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) role?
faq.answer: For the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) role, at least 5 years of experience is required in the actual conduct of meetings/examinations and office procedures.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: You can download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website: http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
